classes.name: Twig\Util\CallableArgumentsExtractor
classes.description: Final class responsible for extracting, normalizing, and validating arguments for callable functions in Twig templates.

methods.name: extractArguments
methods.description: Extracts and validates the arguments passed to a callable node, handling positional, named, optional, and variadic arguments, throwing SyntaxErrors for invalid argument configurations.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Converts argument names to a consistent lowercase, underscore-stripped format for internal processing.

methods.name: toSnakeCase
methods.description: Converts a CamelCase or other formatted string to snake_case.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the parameters of the callable, adjusting for special Twig requirements and variadic arguments.
